random_recall_explanation: For a unique true best and uniform without-replacement keep-k, E[recall@k]=k/N=0.3125. Reported ~0.28 was a finite-sample Monte Carlo estimate (n_pools=2000, seed=123) under the same protocol — not a different sampling model. Re-estimates sit near 0.30–0.31; residual gap to 0.3125 is sampling noise, not duplicates.
